whole_PS2_ISO_literal_reference_scan.includes: Every original ISO file extent, including the entire PAK, all movies/banks/IRX/overlays/ELF/NETGUI; no extraction or asset mutation.
whole_PS2_ISO_literal_reference_scan.scope: Raw NUL-terminated literal strings and standalone stems only. Static code/table joins are in the separately pinned reference receipt. No runtime load, pointer reachability or universal absence claim.

format.format: SEC/SSF
SEC/SSF

models.source: Original PS2 model payloads remain source data.
models.native_GPU_requirement: Decode native-packed geometry/indices/skin into typed native buffers; raw encoded console layout is not automatically a host vertex ABI.
models.evidence_unit: Original encoded section-slot namespace; see actual_resource_name_group_comparison for actual-name group counts. Serialized formats still need typed native decode/binding.

skeletons.native_GPU_requirement: Bind to typed native hierarchy/skin matrices; exact matching chunks may retain values, but pointer/ABI layout is still native.
skeletons.evidence_unit: Original encoded section-slot namespace; see actual_resource_name_group_comparison for actual-name group counts. Serialized formats still need typed native decode/binding.

arenas.source: Preserve original PS2 arena SSF resources; all original BGS-to-descriptor joins listed.
arenas.native_GPU_requirement: The container may remain serialized source input; its model/texture/script components need their own native binding/conversion.

textures.source: Keep PS2 source textures; no Xbox substitution.
textures.native_GPU_requirement: Decode palette/swizzle/console packet representation and upload native pixel resources. Header/type/hash differences alone do not establish decoded pixel equality.
textures.evidence_unit: Original encoded section-slot namespace; see actual_resource_name_group_comparison for actual-name group counts. Serialized formats still need typed native decode/binding.

movies.source: Original PS2 SFD bytes can remain input to native demux/video/audio codecs.
movies.native_GPU_requirement: Decode to native surfaces; retain authored aspect/frame timing. Xbox sequence headers differ and are not a resolution-only replacement.

sound-banks.source: Keep original PS2 bank/codec data; Xbox split-bank layout does not replace it.
sound-banks.native_GPU_requirement: Native bank parsing and audio decode/output, no emulated sound-device ABI. NETGUI banks are inventoried only; online remains out of scope.

scripts.source: Keep original script data semantics; distinguish constants/strings from executable logic.
scripts.native_GPU_requirement: Executable retail logic follows static generated C++/typed-native transformation; do not pass through guest pointers, a guest VM or an interpreter. Equal serialized bytes alone earn no native credit.

whole_disc.owner_decision: Xbox-only content remains OPEN; no integration, asset replacement or runtime path mapping changes.

Every supplemental PS2 movie/bank hash matched original ISO extent

namespace_detail.unit: Original bundle/section/type/name/occurrence slot keys; structural metadata namespace detail, not actual-name groups or exclusive game content.

logical_sound_bank_comparison.count_contract: 344 named logical bank labels: compare original PS2 named MST metadata bytes with same-label Xbox MBX metadata bytes. Xbox MSX accompanies each MBX. Different serialized metadata does not establish different decoded sound content.

self_tests.planted_label_suffix: PASS: fake_no_corresponding_bank not in actual label intersection

format_limits: PS2 type2 shared MS2 directory contains named MST banks plus numeric payload entries; MS4 alternate resources use explicit resource+0x10 offset/+0x14 length and flag at+0x20.

Xbox type11 MBX and same-label MSX are separate original XDVDFS files; flags and encoded metadata differ. No PS2 parser is applied to Xbox MSX inner records; only its proven whole-file range/hash is claimed.
No arbitrary resource-ordinal/key equivalence, sample payload pairing, codec equality, decoded PCM identity or runtime sound parity is established.

policy.dsstdfx.bin: Separate Xbox sndsxbox physical auxiliary, not one of344 MBX/MSX bank pairs; no corresponding named PS2 bank label established; owner decision OPEN.
policy.NETGUI.BD/NETGUI.HD: Separate PS2 online sound banks outside MSL344 comparison; retained in physical inventory only, online out of scope.
